preconditions.description: The input must be a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in reindeer_names)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list must be a string.
Each string must be composed of exactly two words.

postconditions.description: The output must be a list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be a string.
The output list must have the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: sorted(return_value, key=lambda name: name.split()[1]) == sorted(reindeer_names, key=lambda name: name.split()[1])
postconditions.description: The output list must be sorted by the last names of the reindeer.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i].split()[1] <= return_value[i+1].split()[1] for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: The last names in the output list must be in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i].split()[1] == return_value[i+1].split()[1] or return_value[i].split()[1] < return_value[i+1].split()[1] for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: The last names in the output list must be in non-decreasing order, with ties preserved.
